decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8234. Series context: trend strength 0.9824 and seasonal strength 0.2465; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.361); 8 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 9.208.
